risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- Currency fluctuations are accentuated by global trade disputes and sanctions, which can impact profitability.
- Trade barriers and tariffs influence the international pricing landscape, requiring dynamic sourcing and pricing strategies.
- Due diligence and financial instruments such as letters of credit are crucial to navigate global trade complexities.
- Insured storage and transportation are needed to mitigate losses due to geopolitical conflicts, tariffs, and supply chain disruptions.
- Escalating tariffs, trade wars, quota limitations, export bans and non-tariff barriers in major economies threaten the free flow of commodities and restrict export volumes, raising costs and market uncertainty.
- Rising logistics and supply chain costs, driven by geopolitical tensions and disruptions, diminish margins.
- Unpredictable monsoon patterns and climate change threaten crop yields, impacting domestic supply and exports.
- Labour shortages, especially in agricultural sectors, are exacerbated by migration, border restrictions, and labor laws.
